notes.title: 1.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are doing great ! Time has come, Pure Rock Crawling is transitioning from Early Access to a full release today ![/b]

But before getting more into this, here is what's new in this update:

[h3][b]Winter map update[/b][/h3]
The Winter Map was revamped with new challenges. I redid most of the rock placement, which was necessary because of the new map-making standard. This allowed for the introduction of rocks with physics. This makes for more fluid gameplay, not getting stuck on small rocks which was a big issue with the Winter map. Few graphical changes were made, mainly in materials and rock blending to match the aesthetics of the rest of the maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/9f4fac3cab98c16b5c0da2c1207a95553809aa09.png[/img]

[h3][b]New map menu[/b][/h3]
I redesigned the map selection menu to improve clarity and implement the new scoring system. The revamped menu now shows map progress which is a part of the new scoring system and provides additional information. I have also improved the UI movement and gamepad focus for smoother navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/676c168a1cb7e108bc87c6f74412da7aaeb7ef18.png[/img]

[h3][b]Score system - track progress[/b][/h3]
Now you can track your progress on every map. This new UI is accessible from challenge boards and replaces the old system. Every challenge has its details listed, from type of cone to terrain elevation. Alongside these changes, I added several new challenges across all of the maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/ca4b45875b07558699bbb57ce855ba1dd95063ce.png[/img]

[h3][b]Pricing and rewards update[/b][/h3]
To further balance the gameplay, pricing of items has been adjusted. Pure Rock Crawling prioritizes a relaxed, simulation-focused gameplay and is more focused on realistic physics simulation and deformable tires. Yet, a little challenge won't spoil the fun. By carefully balancing these elements, the game creates a truly enjoyable and immersive rock crawling experience.

[h3][b]New achievements[/b][/h3]
I redesigned existing achievements icons and added completely new achievements as well. Now, besides the number of passed gates and tripped cones, you can unlock additional achievements for using the trailer, earning credits and others. Have fun completing them all !

[h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3] 
There were a few minor bugs, primarily in the customization UI. That's taken care of now. The mini map is now more readable and has the same, consistent style across all maps. I have also made a few subtle tweaks to the simulation here and there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/b0b7e7b9f6dd6bcd46a2302c8fca5ab9ef86371f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Thank you ![/b][/h1]

Pure Rock Crawling is more than a game for me. For more than 6 years it has been my whole life. Back in 2018, with no prior game development experience, I embarked on what I thought would be a year-long journey at best. As I mentioned in the early access release form: “Pure Rock Crawling should come out of Early Access in roughly 6-10 months.” Well, here we are, 78 months later. But every moment has been worthwhile and no time was wasted. During early access, I made 67 updates to the game, and together with all your support, it allowed Pure Rock Crawling to evolve far beyond my imagination, my initial vision and finally beyond what I’d thought I could make.

For instance, the first version of Pure Rock Crawling didn't even have customization. Not because it wasn’t ready but because I simply didn't know how to make such a system and implement it. Though I didn’t plan it in the first version. Not to mention features like difflock 4WD engagement/disengagement which were also absent.

[b]Now that Pure Rock Crawling is officially out of Early Access, I would like to say:[/b]

Thanks to all of you, the whole community, for supporting me and Pure Rock Crawling. Thanks for seeing the potential in this game and more than there was at a time. From finding simple bugs to suggesting core mechanics that were implemented in the final game, your input shared on the forums was an invaluable asset during the game’s development. 

Thanks to my family and friends, for being there for me, for listening about game development, and showing your interest and support.

Biggest thank you to my wife. You believed in me from the day I said “How about I make a video game”. Thank you for every time we discussed math problems and what a vector dot product is.

[list]
[h3][b]Q&A[/b][/h3]

[*]Why no heads up ?

I opted to leave myself room for delays rather than disappointing anybody with a delayed launch. Think of it as a nice surprise.

[*]Why full release ? Why now ?

With this update Pure Rock Crawling became core feature complete. There is no need to be in Early Access anymore. However, this doesn't mean it won’t receive future content updates and general bug fixes.

[*]What changes for current players

Nothing, it just means that Pure Rock Crawling is out of Early Access. Old saved games should work. If you are having any problems or just want to start from scratch you can delete save files in this directory: %LOCALAPPDATA% \PureRockCrawling\Saved\SaveGames

[*]Are you really just one developer ?

Yes
[/list]

[b]Cheers and take care ![/b]

notes.title: WHEEL SUPPORT
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! Wheel support received a massive overhaul.[/b]

As you may remember, there is an ongoing effort to make working wheel support, and this update is the next step towards this goal. There were multiple bugs and issues recently. Pure Rock Crawling is still under development, and on some occasions things like updating the engine version or core mechanics can cause other things to have problems. This one was severe, which I was aware of. I put much effort and many development hours to fix most of the issues. I tested it thoroughly on my end and the changes made work fine with my setup. I hope that they will work for you as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/307c26cfc35cfd9e2f512b4ff1cce920050e89bb.png[/img]

But first, if you are using a wheel with Pure Rock Crawling, you will have to map axes and buttons from scratch. There is a new save system for that and it requires new bindings to be made. Second, a heads up that the update size is big, which is due to updating the engine version.

Additionally, if you happen to use deadzone options or invert axis in the advanced menu, these may or may not be wrong too. You may want to delete the following save file:

[b]%LOCALAPPDATA% \PureRockCrawling\Saved\SaveGames\controller.sav[/b]

[b]Remember, you need to bind every input in the Options menu. No wheel will be recognized and work right out of the box with Pure Rock Crawling.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/6ddf59273c76a9bc2a37588b6e936c5bb0441e46.png[/img]

Checklist to help me help you if you are still having issues with the steering wheel:

[list]
[*] Did you rebind your steering wheel ? 
[*] Update drivers for your steering wheel, software and firmware
[*] Make sure that your wheel software is running
[*] Has your setup changed recently ? try rebinding axes and buttons
[*] Does any wheel input work ?
[*] Does your keyboard and/or mouse work ?
[*] Do input indicators in the advanced menu move at all ?
[*] Does your setup work with other games ?
[/list]
I created a new topic in the forum to track down current issues, please if you are experiencing any, describe it in this topic:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/824720/discussions/0/4520010682808868794/]WHEEL SUPPORT DISCUSSION THREAD[/url]

Thanks !

notes.title: GENERAL UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing well ! Although, this update took more time to develop than expected, it brings many improvements and new elements to Pure Rock Crawling.[/b]

Let's run through these changes :)

[list]
[*] [b]Graphical improvements[/b]
Earlier, the game used a very unoptimized sharpening material in the post-process. This resulted in not as sharp textures and blurring behind the moving vehicle. The new method, which is more engine based, improved greatly looks of the game and gave it much more refined look
[*] [b]New UI[/b]
Whole game UI was redone. The purpose was mainly to fix the issues that you might have encountered while switching between the input devices. The other benefit of this change is the new, refreshed look of all the menus in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/40e4d81c3df9fa5b3633139df175b28141cb167c.png[/img]
After the implemented changes, the buttons stay in focus for the device. This fixes the lost input problem where you weren't able to select any button. Moreover, the whole loop of menus and interact widgets was reorganized and therefore leads to much more fluid gameplay. Now you don't have to back out to the main menu whenever you want to go back to options menu.
[*] [b]Garage[/b]
Implementing this feature took a while, but I am so happy how it turned out. You now have access to the garage, which is placed on the main maps and marked on mini map, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/c46c9b7053ea9083c75aea9c73c7b5156901aaf6.png[/img]
The garage is your hub and access point to the customization and vehicle selection menu. It also gives you the option to fast travel between the maps. Again, the garage greatly improves the gameplay by not having to quit the game to main menu to change your vehicle or select a map. Hope you will like it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/29fb971f8b9c5e369adac926c90240c2f7e64a85.png[/img]
[*] [b]Travel points[/b]
Switching between the maps is now integrated into the level design. Inspired by US National Parks' entrances, now you can simply drive to the end of the map and will be presented with the map selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/90bf6fd5d6540e39e983b2920a48687a817ac079.png[/img]
[*] [b]Physics[/b]
As always there is something to improve with the physics system. The newest changes eliminate shaky wheels when not driving. Also, the whole physics simulation now runs smoother and faster. This also eliminated bugs with tires glitching into the terrain when they were changed in the customization menu.
[*] [b]Options[/b]
Alongside UI update, the options menu got solid rework. The wheel configuration was separated for more clarity and easier setup. Again, all of the UI elements now keep track of your input and result in smooth navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/c8ef3b98224554067afa156068135f076475396f.png[/img]
[*] [b]Other [/b]
[list]
[*] fixed lag spike on startup
[*] fixed collisions having wrong properties on the Winter map, resulting in lag spikes on smaller rocks
[*] fixed unnecessary assets being packaged with shipping build of the game, resulting in 50% game file reduction
[*] fixed loosing input from steering wheel and other devices
[*] tutorial is now updated with the new systems and features (if you want to rerun tutorial you have to delete tutorial save file from the game save directory)
[*] multiplayer is now moved to separate build (available in beta tab in steam game properties). I hope to get back to it in the future and make it more playable. Sadly, as of right now it blocks further development of the game as it interferes too much with current changes (especially wheel support) causing a whole bunch of bugs. For now, it is too hard to keep it updated and work on these things simultaneously.
[*] desert map is currently not playable, I was trying to save it but for now it does not work with recent changes, newly implemented features and graphical improvements. It will see a rework in the foreseeable future.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Hope you like the changes. There is still a lot to come :) As always, if you have any issues or suggestions, please write it down in the forums ! See you in the next update ![/b]

notes.title: CHALLENGES UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! Updated challenge system is here ![/b]

But first, HAPPY NEW YEAR !!!!! I wish you all the best and at the same time I would like to thank you for all the support you give me ! Pure Rock Crawling has just passed 1000 reviews :O This is a huge news for me, as a solo developer, and it is quite overwhelming ! 

As for the update, for the long time there was no clarity in what player should do in free roam. There were challenge boards which activated selected trails but that required a lot of travel with no purpose. This update changes that into much more player friendly system.

Now, heading to the challenge board will gain you access to actual challenges, composed of selected trails, with different obstacles to tackle. This will be the core of progressing in Pure Rock Crawling. In the future there will be more challenges added that will enhance the gameplay experience with more activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/3af457723fd1821ed12fe5f32ff9e2678b6a7402.png[/img]

As for free roam gameplay, there is a massive change in selecting desired trails. You can now simply drive to the trail head and select type of challenge as you please. This way you don't have to drive to challenge board every time you want to activate a trail challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/f6cc0b0ef79b14392688f12b7803233d26d07d52.png[/img]

Every available trail head is now marked on the minimap with a cross.

This new system utilizes new UI method of detecting player input, this fixes the problems with lost gamepad focus and overlaying input from mouse and gamepad. This is a work in progress and it will see another updates that add to the gameplay experience.

Thanks again for the support, and as always, if you have any issues with the update, please write in the forums. Even if something is not changed right away i want to assure you that I keep track of everything posted there. It is just not possible for me to work on everything at once ;) Hope you understand.

[b]Have fun with new challenges and take care ![/b]

notes.title: DRIVETRAIN UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing well ! This update focuses on 3 things, input, UI and drivetrain.[/b]

Lets start with drivetrain update. Since drivetrain in Pure Rock Crawling is fully physical simulation, which means both torque applied to the differential and difflock can be controlled separately for front and rear. It is direct influence from few updates ago where I reworked the whole system. But until now there was only four wheel drive and difflock on or off for both axles. With today's update you can now disengage 4x4 and remain in 2x4 drive with rear wheels being driven. Additionally you can choose to lock diffs both for front and rear independently. This truly shows the physical simulation behind these systems :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/3144f52aa992f6e3b53ff201c28b013ca1b28370.png[/img]
Adding these options required some improvements in the UI to show the player current status of the drivetrain. So I added whole new UI to the game showing what is currently engaged and whats not. Adding to this I cleaned up the gearbox widget and moved the pitch/roll indicator to make it more clear to read.

Lastly I added indicators of what your key bindings currently are to avoid being confused about what button lock which diff :) Also If you are controller player, UI will show separate icons for gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/573a8ee79c51ebecba67177556700e194d823756.png[/img]



[b]*IMPORATNT* for keyboard players

You may encounter problems with key bindings. It could show as having multiple functions attached to one key. To remedy this you may have to delete this file (to be safe make a backup copy of it): 

%LOCALAPPDATA% \PureRockCrawling\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\input.ini[/b]



Full update list:
[list]
[*] fixed reverse being overpowered and with no engine sounds
[*] fixed gearbox loosing gear after crash
[*] ability to change 4x4 to 2x4
[*] separate difflock control
[*] UI improvements
[*] tire grip tweaks
[*] UI key mapping hints
[*] improvemed gamepad UI settings
[/list]
As always, if you have any problems or suggestions, let me know in the forums !

[b]Take care and have fun ![/b]

notes.title: SUSPENSION UPDATE

Also now ride height preset by lift kit doesn't affect side to side movement, as if you would adjust Panhard bar to not have axle on one side sticking out to far. 

Also worked on few parameters regarding synchronization in multiplayer.

Thanks for the help and if you have any issues with suspension, post it on the forums !

[b]Cheers ![/b]

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY ! - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all well ! Pure Rock Crawling is celebrating 5th birthday ![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/23ae441b7e42a91f5604b4192dc885f2302041e1.png[/img]

In this update I have addressed a few things that were quite frustrating to deal with for a long time.
First, the tire grip. Before, the main factors defining tires were mass, contact surface, and dimensions, while physical material was always the same. It was not by my urge or purpose to make things simple, but the logic behind such physical tires' behavior was much more complicated at the time. Finally, I came up with a suitable solution to the problem. Now, each tire is categorized with its performance on snow/sand, gravel/road, or rocks. For now, the tire performance is represented in customization menu and will be better visualized later. Second, tires' physics has been also improved, resulting in much better stability at higher speeds.

Suspension characteristics have been also enhanced. Now, every suspension type behaves like it should, with things like the Panhard bars pushing axle side to side and links arrangement making difference to the stability. Alongside this change, the suspension physics are also improved giving better feel and more realistic response.

The engine, gearbox, throttle response, and power curves have been adjusted to sound and perform better. Now, the vehicles change the gears in the auto mode more realistically, sound better, and can drive faster. Also, the new throttle curve allows for a smoother start.

As for the anniversary,
Thanks for the amazing five years ! The way this game evolved during this time is far beyond what i have expected it to be. If anyone is wondering why it is still in Early Access, it is because the scope of the game grew and grew. it was never my intention for it to be this big. Yeah, it could be finished in its original form from 2018 in a year or so. However, having such and an amazing community around who wanted this game to look better and play better, I could not do that. I want this game to be the best I can do, so if that means more time in EA, I am all for it. It just means more updates for you ;) That is not to say, I want it to be stuck in EA forever. I will do my best to finish this game as quickly as I can, but this has to be done step by step and in a manner that will not harm the quality :)

Thanks again ! Cheers !

notes.title: Improvements, Physics and Wheel Support !
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! This update is entirely dedicated to all of you, posting on the forums, finding bugs and suggesting improvements and features ! Let's get to it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/00edd3f56996b62addfb824104d56eac7c70a978.png[/img]

This update is one of these times when one thing leads to another. As you know, wheel support was a little bit clunky, and to be honest I was never truly happy about it. That was just the best solution I could come up with at the time. So, many tries later, new version is finally here ! Now you can use multiple input devices, H-shifter and bind buttons ! I will add a new thread on the forum to track supported wheels and any issues with this new system.

Wheel support rework led to another major issue of how the cars were driven. Let me clarify, before this update wheels were driven by determining their rotation (not torque applied). This was fine in most cases and allowed for having locked differentials. However, having rotation determined by function posed a problem, how to simulate open differential behavior. The solution was to torque driven and to put an actual, fully physics driven differentials with locking option and it worked ! Now everything regarding drivetrain is pure physics !

Another long awaited fix are the brakes. Before, they were composition of applying reverse torque and predefined rotation. Now they are driven by the actual friction on discs brakes !

With all that implemented, there was finally a good time to finish up UI. It had to make room for key bindings, hence improved wheel support , so I touched it up across the game too.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] more lift options
[*] fixed bug with customization data tables
[*] new options menu
[*] improved suspension stability
[*] vehicle select no longer kick back to main menu
[*] improved navigation in customization menu
[*] options menu stores previously selected settings
[*] gear up/down binding for wheels
[*] new torque based physics
[*] new brake system that is proportional on controllers/wheels
[*] physical differential
[*] improved wheel/device support 
[*] wheel support key bindings
[*] H-shifter support
[*] camera sensitivity option now has more range
[*] selected vehicle is stored as default
[*] new map/stage UI
[*] removed level cap and timer from levels
[/list]

[b]Thank you again for all the suggestions that led to this update ! I hope I solved most of the main issues you had with Pure Rock Crawling. I am now jumping straight back to making a new map ! Cheers ![/b]

notes.title: QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing well ! This update brings you a lot of improvements ! From manual gearbox to tire deformation.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/79fb759ee387dd504682666c6f427fd064871732.jpg[/img]

Let's start with the most important, manual gearbox is here ! This, I must admit should be in the game from day one. But developing this system was far more complicated than I would have ever thought. Now you can change gears using your mouse and the controller. Of course there is still automatic mode for you to select.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/f50a0dfca07539182cb2c4bf5284dd5b130bb8d3.jpg[/img]

I want to thank all of you who pushed me to implement this feature in the game ! Now I cant imagine the game without it ! If you have any suggestions regarding gearbox please let me know in the forums.

Alongside gearbox being in the game, now there is a proper break. Thanks to having now reverse gear separated from brake - I know, finally :) This lead me to another improvement, vehicles now don't stop after reapplying throttle which results in a much smoother gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/6e65a3612578ffec868c09700f3121b0db3b3cc9.jpg[/img]

Another key improvement is the fix of excessive tire deformation. Rims are not deforming now and side ways deformation was reserved only for skinny tires - on the other ones it was replaced with angular deformation which is far closer to real tire deformation. This also fixed excessive side slipping. Thank you for spotting these problems !

Next is suspension simulation. I changed the way suspension is being simulated. Previously there was linear drive forced axles to stay at given height with set force. This was a problem because once the suspension was raised it became stiffer. Also it didn't quite worked as spring should. Now there is a proper spring simulation for the suspension, and raising is performed on other constraint resulting in equally soft suspension whichever height you choose.

Fixing this made me realize that part of the code responsible for better flex simulation was not working since last update. Its fixed now.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] manual gearbox
[*] excessive wheel deformation fix
[*] side to side deformation replaced with angular
[*] vehicle no longer stop after reapplying throttle
[*] new engine load calculations
[*] vehicle are less prone to side slipping
[*] new spring calculations for suspension
[*] fixed suspension getting to stiff when raised
[*] fixed bug that caused different suspension types act the same
[*] changed method of height adjustment
[*] brake and throttle separated

notes.title: NEW SUSPENSION CUSTOMIZATION
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/99e1b3cad141fd75a970b03db635bf25471bdddc.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! This update changes how can you customize your truck suspension. Now you can choose between 6 different setups, both for front and rear - and mix them up! [/b]

Let me start with specifying what has changed. In the customization menu now you have the ability to choose different suspension types. This allows you to customize your truck in a whole new dimension. Let's say that you want 3 link in the front and leaf springs in the back - no problem ! One link setup ? Got you covered :) Each type is modeled with attention to every nut and bolt. Let me list every available option:
[list]
[*] One Link with Panhard bar - front/rear
[*] Two link with Panhard bar - front/rear
[*] Three link - front with Panhard rear triangulated
[*] Four link triangulated  - front/rear
[*] Five link (4 with Panhard) - front/rear
[*] Leaf spring - front/rear
[/list]
Every suspension has its own characteristic, eg. one link is very unstable but gives the most flex and on the other hand there are leaf springs, the most stable and predictable but the worst flex. Also Panhard bars push suspension to one side etc. Once I polish these values they will be exposed in the customization menu so it will be easier to compare them. Feel free to comment and give suggestions on how each type could be tweaked.

In addition to that, axles got a lifting too. Now you can see working axles shafts with exposed u-joints. New engine model etc. Whole new suspension to play with.
As for the overall look of customization, right now the UI is a mess and needs to be changed. 

Suspension change don't require in-game currency, and from now on parts that affect gameplay won't require it. In the future I want to separate mechanical parts from cosmetic ones - but that will be a whole another update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/b7a245707670f532266a9098e6a85157417c1f60.jpg[/img]

Other thing that was added is nvidia ansel. You can now use this tool to take in game screenshots having freedom to move the camera around to get the best angle possible ! Also this helped me to take pictures for today's update.

Also got a fixed a few bugs and improved some things:
[list]
[*] driver animation not working corectly when using controller
[*] fixed issue with car loosing power in certain situations
[*] changed acceleration curve, plus removed a bug where two methods of calculating load interfered
[*] camera center of rotation moved closer to center of car

[b]Hi ! Time to adres few things in the vehicle physics, including one of the most requested one - vehicle speed. Let's get to it ![/b]

So, since day one the vehicle speeds were limited, or even got slower as the updates were rolling and whole car physics model was becoming more complicated. Increasing speed resulted in very floaty physics and collision problems. Since the vehicles are made in a unique way, not relying on the default ray-cast method, the game engine was struggling. Also tires are very different from what you can find in other games and are really pushing the engine limits. 

Every time when working on update I was trying to fix all of this, and finally I was able to !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/8899a2f9f04c39dc09f931d235ef77b0e5283c3c.jpg[/img]

Now the physics feel more agile, vehicles can go faster and the physics are more stable - resulting in much more realistic experience !

Big thanks to the community for all of the suggestions ! Now you will be able to reach your favorite locations much faster :)

[b]I hope you will like the changes ! Stay tuned for the next update ![/b]

notes.title: Happy Birthday ! Anniversary Update

[b]Hi ! Here we are, one year later :) Time to sum up past 12 months and plan the future ! But first, the actual update :)[/b]

[h1][b]NEW VEHICLE[/b][/h1]
Since one year ago the buggy type vehicle was added to the game, I thought it would be a right time to reveal the new buggy. Its lighter and faster than other vehicles, also features bigger tires. Have fun :)

[h1][b]GRAPHICS UPDATE[/b][/h1]
I took some time to rework the lighting on all maps, to better suit the overall look of the game. I hope the game now feels more toned down and much more realistic :) As I was changing this stuff I went ahead and change some vegetation on spring maps, as much as I am in new maps I think that the game really will benefit from this change and help the old maps not stand out so much.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/4c52807947cb61f77a03a307d6ab059475b12d14.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]MINOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] car physics should be more responsive now, there was linear drag applied to car body causing it to "float" when moving faster.
[*] improved camera, I hope it will help everyone who felt dizzy while playing
[*] fixed bug that caused no feedback from buttons on score widget
[*] more CPU calculations for body velocity and position, should improve smoothness
[*] fixed bug that caused no money earned from the first ever stage
[*] more money for clean stage completion
[/list]

[b]And now... lets sum up this year ![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/4f677783e38bf83a94341451fa05db38283206c0.jpg[/img]

I have never thought that this game is going to evolve so much, that it would have customization, wheel support with force feedback, proper cockpit view and if you are here from day one then probably you remember the struggle to make proper diff lock :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/8a57d5d9a6084d62a904c538897d2c970407da92.jpg[/img]

And that's all thanks to all of you. Pushing me to make new things, fix the old ones, really that means a lot. I may be not the most communicative dev, but i hope you feel that i am reading every suggestion and comment, and that i am truly committed to this as an Early Access where players have impact on the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/3475c8cea8b56f2c010bec43f277041b3b7d48f4.jpg[/img]

That being said, Pure Rock Crawling will remain in Early Access for now. It would be wasted opportunity to leave it too soon, when the game still can benefit from players suggestions.

[b]As for the future :) I have some ideas that I am constantly testing and also your requests. So here is the rough list of what to expect from this game in the future:
[/b]
[list]
[*] update car models, as well as suspension, i think i can do much better now
[*] rework customization, I want to make something that would really let you feel like building dream rock crawler. Different tire sizes/types, axles that actually change something, being able to chose between spring or leaf suspension, more cosmetic items etc., so that's something that i want to work hard on.
[*] different progression system, since i find levels/credits in current form a little annoying
[*] multiplayer and mod support, so these are the tough ones. Don't get me wrong, I want both in game as soon as possible ! Both require the game to be more finished than it is right now (especially mod support) so first things first. Once i settle on how the core mechanics work, I will start working on these features. Cant say anything for sure but I will try as hard as i can :)
[/list][b]Looking back on how much Pure Rock Crawling changed in the past 12 months i am sure there is much more to come !!!

Thank you all for the support ! Cheers and have fun !
[/b]

[b]Hi ! Just finished working on newest update, which was meant to be a lot smaller but i just got carried away :) To be honest, working on this game is getting better and better with each update. Overcoming problems that I felt were impossible to solve at the beginning of this journey, feels just awesome and makes me wanna do more and more ! :)[/b]

Ok so, in today's update :

[h1][b]KEY BINDINGS[/b][/h1]

Sorry to keep you waiting so long ;) 

[h1][b]CAR DAMAGE SYSTEM[/b][/h1]

This is just early test so don't expect to much :) I hope it will make you be more careful drivers, for now it is just cosmetic.

[h1][b]REWORKED CAR ENGINE PHYSICS[/b][/h1]

So, before this update, differential lock was jumping between two systems. One made for locked diffs which was giving the wheels a specific angle to be at the given time. Second for open ones, giving the specific angular velocity. This was very imperfect, but i just couldn't make my mind which will be better in the long run. With this update i made my mind and went for the first one. This required some tricky calculations to make the car behave naturally but gave me full control, power, load, gears. Now the system is more complete with: working automatic gearbox, exhaust smoke reacting to engine load, and low range being more powerful.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/15e78eb3324e70599210b402145620411a13f91b.jpg[/img]

The new 3rd person camera system is making looking around and keeping the eye on the track easier because of moving pivot point. Now you don't have to scroll the mouse wheel all the time. If you look from the above system is trying to put the car near border of the screen so you can see where you are going. Looking from front also makes more space in front of the car. Side effect of this system are of course killer screenshots ! :)

Alongside working on 3rd person camera, I made possible moving the head around in the 1st person view, and as community suggested (thanks all for great suggestion !), you can look out through the window !

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z8wyiQZ.gif[/img]

Designing new trails, positioning rocks is really demanding, and just takes time. Also i took some time to finish up interactive foliage !

[h1][b]MINOR UPDATES[/b][/h1]
